checks.name: SEMANTIC_TO_DISPATCH mapping
checks.note: multiple semantic operations collapse onto one dispatch class; the mapping is not injective, so a dispatch job cannot recover which semantic operation it came from

decisive_assessment.what_it_does: copies d.expected_work_key (v2 preimage, includes measure_kind + condition_order) VERBATIM into an A05-shaped record with operation_key=d.semantic_operation_key
decisive_assessment.why_that_cannot_close_the_defect: A05's verify() compares manifest job keys against keys A05 computes itself from {item_k,op_k,authority,risk,topology,version}. v2's preimage differs, so the translated keys cannot equal A05's keys; an A05 run over them fails set equality, and forcing a pass would require rewriting the oracle's keys - exactly the coercion A04R forbade
decisive_assessment.honest_resolution: SCHEMA_VERSIONED_SUCCESSOR_WITH_A_VERIFIED_PREIMAGE_MAPPING (each v2 semantic key must be paired with an A05-scope key by an explicit, verified, injective mapping - not by copying)
